name: pulser audio
changelog:
• Offline Shuffle Isolation: Shuffling offline playlists or All Tracks stays strictly within local offline tracks with zero online streaming leaks
• Robust Playback Context: Seamlessly isolates offline library playback from online Discover & Flow streaming
• Clean Offline Queue End: Reaching the end of an offline playlist stops cleanly or loops locally with repeat
• Pure Desktop Electron Experience: Full Linux (.deb) and Windows (.exe) desktop audio playback
